evidence.fact: On Epoch AI's FrontierMath v2 (Tiers 1-3) benchmark leaderboard evaluated via Python-enabled iterative reasoning on private math problems, OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol leads with a score of 89.00%.
On Epoch AI's FrontierMath v2 (Tier 4) leaderboard evaluating research-level mathematics expansion problems, OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol achieves a leading score of 83.00%.
On the official ARC Prize leaderboard for ARC-AGI-1 semi-private set evaluation, OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna achieves 90.7% accuracy at a cost of $0.07 per task under max reasoning effort.
On the official ARC Prize leaderboard for ARC-AGI-2 semi-private set evaluation, OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna scores 59.6% accuracy at $0.18 per task under max reasoning effort.
On the official ARC Prize leaderboard, Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 scores 97.5% on ARC-AGI-1, 90.4% on ARC-AGI-2, and 30.16% on ARC-AGI-3.
On the official ARC Prize leaderboard, Google's Gemini 3.6 Flash achieves 91.2% on ARC-AGI-1 and 60.4% on ARC-AGI-2.
On the official ARC Prize leaderboard, xAI's Grok 4.5 achieves an 87.2% score on ARC-AGI-1, 52.6% on ARC-AGI-2, and 0.32% on ARC-AGI-3.
On the official ARC Prize leaderboard, Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 scores 94.5% on ARC-AGI-1 and 60.4% on ARC-AGI-2.
On the official ARC Prize leaderboard, DeepSeek's DeepSeek V4 Flash scores 89.0% on ARC-AGI-1 and 61.4% on ARC-AGI-2.
On the official ARC Prize leaderboard, Thinking Machines' Inkling Small (xHigh reasoning setting) achieves 84.0% on ARC-AGI-1 and 40.1% on ARC-AGI-2 at $0.233 per task.
Epoch AI released FrontierMath v2 on June 12, 2026, correcting errors in 42% of problems across a dataset consisting of 338 total problems (295 in Tiers 1-3 base set and 43 in Tier 4 expansion set).
On the official ARC Prize leaderboard, Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 achieves 98.5% on ARC-AGI-1 and 89.2% on ARC-AGI-2.
